trans-unit.source: No matter where we go, it's sand as far as the eye can see...
trans-unit.target: No matter where we go, it's sand as far as the eye can see...

trans-unit.source: He just has to be around here somewhere.
trans-unit.target: He just has to be around here somewhere.

trans-unit.source: Let's stop wandering aimlessly and find a town. We need to gather information.
trans-unit.target: Let's stop wandering aimlessly and find a town. We need to gather information.

trans-unit.source: Well, what are we waiting for!? Shade, shade!
trans-unit.target: Well, what are we waiting for!? Shade, shade!
